text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan defeats the "Eternal Big 
Three," brilliantly overturning what 
seemed like predetermined history. Inari 
One and Super Creek celebrate her victory 
alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Oguri Cap praised Mejiro Ardan's 
running, calling it a radiance akin to 
colorful glassware.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, cheers erupted from the crowd 
praising her victory, declaring them not 
the "Eternal Big Three," but the "Eternal 
Big Four" with Mejiro Ardan included.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Now," with the utmost brilliance, the 
eternal light of Mejiro Ardan's trail has 
been carved into history.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having poured out every ounce of her 
strength, Mejiro Ardan listened to the 
venue's resounding cheers of blessing as 
she leaned on her Trainer for support—
